description:
Bogdana Ngo is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 43, he has the kind of face that changes depending on the light â€” trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible â€” neural interface jack at base of skull â€” standard runner-grade, allows direct ne â€” and he makes no effort to hide it.

He taught himself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know him best. He works as a fixer out of Meridian Station, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Bogdana Ngo lacks in subtlety, he compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Being captured alive â€” death is preferable to corporate interrogation

blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle

psychology.secret: Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.

daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity â€” mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

2. Evade â€” avoid the problem entirely if possible

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation â€” checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Keeps a physical paper notebook â€” no digital record of personal thoughts
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Counts ammunition obsessively â€” knows the exact round count at all times
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip â€” paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust â€” the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Losing their primary augmentation â€” the one that defines their professional identity
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Complex global ancestry reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora: Southeast Asian (26%), Eastern European (18.5%), Northern European (17.4%), South Asian (17%), Middle Eastern (12.6%), and Sub-Saharan African (8.5%). This genetic confluence produces a striking phenotype â€” warm golden-brown skin with olive and amber undertones, wide-set eyes reflecting continental diversity, and facial architecture that blends Southeast Asian cheekbone prominence with Eastern European angularity and Middle Eastern nasal character. The Sub-Saharan African ancestry contributes subtle warmth and luminosity to the complexion.
physical_description.build: Rawboned and lean â€” economical frame suggesting decades of calculated living rather than deprivation. Muscle definition visible in forearms and shoulders, but overall spare, efficient. The kind of body that moves without wasted motion.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with salt-gray threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to the skull, maintained with military precision
physical_description.eye_color: Cybernetic â€” chrome iris rings surrounding dark pupils, capable of thermal overlay and low-light enhancement. The rings glow faintly amber when net-jacked
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with amber and olive undertones â€” the luminous product of blended Southeast Asian, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African genetics tempered by Northern and Eastern European ancestry. Creates a complexion that appears to absorb and reflect light distinctly, warm yet sophisticated.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered without being aged. Strong prominent cheekbones with architectural definition reflecting South and Southeast Asian heritage, sharp jawline with Eastern European angularity. Wide-set eyes positioned slightly deep, reflecting genetic diversity. Nose bridge shows subtle Middle Eastern character with slight curvature. Subtle warmth to the undertone from Sub-Saharan African ancestry visible in how light plays across the planes of the face. Minimal facial hair â€” kept to a precise shadow. Fine creases around the eyes and mouth suggest more scowling than smiling. Skin shows the wear of a life lived in transition, but maintains inherent luminosity.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar at the base of his skull, barely concealed by cropped hair â€” the entry point for the neural interface jack, approximately 3cm in length, pale against his golden-brown skin tone
Network of thin white scars across the inside of both forearms â€” old nerve damage from early augmentation rejection, barely visible unless examined closely
Burn scar on right shoulder blade â€” shaped like a spread hand, faded to pink-gray, sustained during a contract gone wrong in 2219
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull â€” visible when head is tilted or light catches the surgical scar. Cybernetic eyes with chrome iris rings â€” the only deliberate ornamentation on his body, catches light distinctly. No attempt at bio-mimetic concealment. When jacked in, the iris rings shift to pale amber and remain visible even through closed eyelids.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with contained economy â€” no flourish, no wasted gesture. Stands with weight forward slightly, ready to shift direction. Keeps hands visible. Eye contact is deliberate and sustained, unsettling in its consistency. Speech is sparse; long silences don't make him uncomfortable. Breathing is steady and controlled even under stress.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 pragmatism. Dark neutral colors â€” charcoal, matte black, dark gray. Modular jacket with reinforced shoulder panels and hidden pocket architecture. Cargo pants with subtle cargo pockets designed for quick access and discrete carry. Black composite-soled boots suitable for extended standing or rapid movement. Minimal branding â€” functional only. A single piece of jewelry: a worn silver ring on his right index finger, no visible inscription. Clothing is maintained but not pristine â€” the wear pattern of functional gear, not fashion.
